about: Vesicare is supplied to a patient with current chronic constipation whose GP documents supervised bladder training as an available and suitable alternative for overactive bladder.

possible finding: the record holds no line about constipation or the availability of a suitable non-constipating alternative, and solifenacin (Vesicare) is supplied every four weeks for 8 months from December 2025.
Vesicare is supplied monthly but the record states that the chronic constipation has resolved, so there is no finding.
